## History

When [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) accidentally painted the local hall a shocking bright blue, Fred joined [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), Oliver, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to share in their dismay over the disaster. Later, during the ongoing preparations for Miss Lavendar's wedding, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stumbled upon Fred and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) sharing an intimate moment. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) subsequently visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to confide her engagement to Fred.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P24](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0024), [v2 IX A Question of Color P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P2](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0002), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005), +2 more_

## Relationships

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--fred-wright.md)

Fred Wright and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) are engaged to be married. Their romance comes to a head when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally stumbles upon them sharing an intimate moment, prompting [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to visit [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and officially confide her engagement. Prior to their engagement, Fred and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) interacted within their local social circle, including gathering with mutual friends at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to react to the accidental blue painting of the village hall.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P24](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0024), [v2 IX A Question of Color P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028), +7 more_

- Romantically involved with — engaged to be married  <sub>[v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P18](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0018), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P30](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0030)</sub>

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/fred-wright--gilbert-blythe.md)

Fred Wright and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) are comrades who serve together as officers and active members of the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). They participate in community affairs alongside their peers, including attending society meetings to manage local issues like Judson Parker's advertisement fences. They also socialize together in their group of friends, such as gathering at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to lament the disastrous paint job on the town hall.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P48](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0048), [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), +7 more_

- Comrade of — fellow officer and member of the Avonlea Village Improvement Society  <sub>[v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P48](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0048), [v2 IX A Question of Color P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028)</sub>
